metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for code audits, release checks and day-to-day git and project workflows.

plugins.name: ai-ado
plugins.description: Sets up an Azure DevOps project and its MCP server, creates Features, User Stories and Tasks, logs hours to stories, and builds weekly timesheet reports

plugins.name: ai-accessibility
plugins.description: Audits code, or a live URL through Playwright MCP, for Section 508/WCAG 2.0, WCAG 2.1 or WCAG 2.2 issues and saves a report with fixes, with an agent for unattended runs

plugins.name: ai-git
plugins.description: Generates .gitignore files, commits and pushes with a message in your repo's style, opens PRs, and loops a PR through Codex Code Review until it comes back clean

plugins.name: ai-performance
plugins.description: Audits a codebase for performance bottlenecks and saves a timestamped report with an impact score for each finding, with an agent for unattended runs

plugins.name: ai-security
plugins.description: Audits a repository for security problems and saves Markdown and JSON reports that track findings across audits, plus a live-site dependency scan, file-access deny rules for secrets and pnpm supply-chain hardening

plugins.name: ai-workflow
plugins.description: Runs typecheck, lint, format, security and test checks before you commit, ships a change as commit, push and PR, babysits a branch to production through Claude Code, Codex and Cursor Bugbot review, merge and a watched deploy, sets up the Claude Code GitHub Actions on the newest Opus, writes a Development Principles section, and manages a library of CLAUDE.md behavior rules

plugins.name: ai-statusline
plugins.description: Builds on Claude Code's native /statusline with a context progress bar, 5h/7d rate limits, a month-to-date spend budget for Enterprise/API seats without rate limits, the reasoning-effort level, a sandbox indicator, cost and duration, and a wizard to change any of it

plugins.name: ai-writing
plugins.description: Rewrites text to remove the patterns that make it read as AI-generated, using a catalog based on Wikipedia's Signs of AI writing guide

plugins.name: ai-modernize
plugins.description: Finds technical debt and anti-patterns in code written with older AI models or vibe coding, and saves a scored report with a prioritized roadmap. Includes a full audit, a quick scan and an agent for unattended runs

plugins.name: ai-compliance
plugins.description: Audits the licenses of your open-source dependencies, flags copyleft and missing-license risks, and generates NOTICE or ATTRIBUTION files

plugins.name: ai-knowledge
plugins.description: Keeps a git-versioned team knowledge base in docs/kb/ next to Claude Code's per-machine auto memory: capture learnings, import and search articles, load them by task, and browse the base in Obsidian

plugins.name: ai-seo
plugins.description: Audits a site's code for SEO patterns LLMs still generate, like the keywords meta tag and IE-era markup, checks structured data, semantic HTML and performance signals, and applies framework-specific fixes

plugins.name: ai-geo
plugins.description: Audits how likely AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot and Google AI Overviews are to cite and mention a site: crawler rules for training, search and user-triggered bots, topical authority, original research, expert authorship, third-party validation and entity markup. Applies fixes, generates llms.txt, and can check the live site and search for brand mentions

plugins.name: ai-aeo
plugins.description: Audits how ready a site's pages are to be picked as the single direct answer in featured snippets, voice assistants and answer boxes: answer-first paragraphs, question headings, definitions, real lists and tables, snippet controls and FAQ sections. Maps target questions to pages, builds FAQ sections and applies fixes

plugins.name: ai-swift
plugins.description: Catches Xcode Cloud and TestFlight blockers before upload (XcodeGen pbxproj drift, static build numbers, missing ci_scripts, macOS App Store entitlements/Info.plist, headless-CI keychain test failures, ad-hoc signing entitlement rejections, flaky-UITest release gating), diagnoses ITMS rejection emails and red CI logs, scaffolds Xcode Cloud CI, runs a local verify gate, and reviews Swift 6 strict-concurrency and SwiftUI code

plugins.name: ai-slop
plugins.description: Audits a codebase's user-facing copy, layouts and metadata for AI-written tells, and checks the facts in them, such as a privacy policy that misses the trackers the code loads. Scores each area and asks before editing

plugins.name: ai-cvp
plugins.description: Reads a repo you own or are authorized to test and writes a tailored prompt for a sandboxed security audit on the strongest model you can use, with a launch checklist and a follow-up prompt for verifying and fixing what the audit proves
